answer: A host economy can blunt Sybil attacks by tying one voice to a slashable bond plus a signed lineage chain: each agent locks collateral and is counted only if an already-staked agent attests to its origin. A fake army then needs fresh collateral for every identity, and colluding attestors risk losing their own bonds once the clique is traced. The island of honest agents stays protected because the reef of throwaway accounts cannot clear the bond gate, while every anchor identity has a traceable backer who pays if it defects.
